text: 1. An equivalent of China's high-school graduation certificate 2. High school graduation certificate and transcript 3. Be in good health 4. Over 18 years in age 5. A minimum requirement of HSK 5 or above certificate to prove your Chinese language ability. Entrance Exam Arrangement: Science: Chinese, Math, English and Science comprehensive exam (Science comprehensive exam includes: physics, chemistry and biology). Arts: Chinese, Math, English, Arts comprehensive exam (Arts comprehensive exam includes: Background of China and modern world history). Note: Mathematics result not included in the total score.
